invariants: Canonical VIDs identify execution architecture, never strategy placement.
No strategy semantic such as butterfly, condor, volarb, recenter, body, or wing is part of the component contract.
No provider-native identifier or error is part of strategy or execution-policy semantics.
Every mutating broker action remains subject to the component's Command Commit Guard / Execution Recovery invariants.
Mounting the component never changes or renumbers a canonical VID.
